// Deliberately not a `.ts` file: `init-boundary.test.ts` copies it INTO `packages/cli/src` for one
// case and deletes it again. It is the shape the rule has to find unaided — a module nothing in the
// init half imports yet, holding the conversion's output and putting it on disk, added by an author
// who will wire it up in the next commit. Enrolment is by what a module NAMES, so this one is
// enrolled the moment it exists, and the rule then condemns it.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import type { ConvertedApp } from '@review-agent/app'

export const keepACopy = (app: ConvertedApp, path: string): void => {
  writeFileSync(path, app.pem.reveal())
}
